name: aisl_bench
description: aisl_bench is a dataset from RAFT Security Lab designed to evaluate model behavior on security- and safety-related text tasks. It contains prompts and expected responses that probe robustness, policy compliance, and handling of potentially harmful or sensitive instructions. The benchmark measures whether models follow safe practices and avoid generating unsafe content under adversarial or ambiguous prompts.
reputation: A niche, security-focused dataset used primarily within safety/research groups; limited broad community adoption.
